dedupe_keys.name: rac gama model supporting a serious game on solid waste management in a vietnamese commune in the bac hung hai irrigation system

description: RÁC, the Vietnamese word for waste, is a serious game about solid waste management in a commune within the Bắc Hưng Hải irrigation system in Vietnam, and this is the simulation model behind it. It was written on the GAMA platform by Patrick Taillandier, Alexis Drogoul and Léo Biré and published in the CoMSES library in January 2024. The model replicates how waste circulates and what environmental impact it has in four fictive villages; during the game, players take actions and see how their decisions change the simulated outcomes, as a way of supporting discussion among local stakeholders. Version 1.0.0 is available as a free download from CoMSES under the LGPL-3.0 licence and runs in the free GAMA platform. Caveats: the villages are fictive, the model is built for participatory discussion, not prediction, and the page gives no validation data. Coverage is one rural setting in Vietnam. Simulation uses: participatory planning of waste collection and disposal where waste reaches irrigation canals. Related records: the What a Waste global database (data-what-a-waste-global-database) gives national waste statistics for Vietnam and other countries.
